# Cell block recovery controls

Original XML generated by `tools/cell_block_recovery_fixture.py` using Python's
standard library and the existing independent image-recovery fixture builder.
Four packages pair ordinary and nested tables with and without paragraph
`w:pageBreakBefore` in one cell paragraph (ECMA-376 Part 1 §17.3.1.23).

The editor's cell pagination subset rejects that declaration. Before this fix,
the rejection flattened the entire outer table. Recovery must now retain the
owning cell, surrounding styled paragraphs, nested table structure, body images,
numbering, and header, while approximating only the failed paragraph. Strict
import stays guarded and the original download remains unchanged.

Browser comparisons use the counterpart without the rejected declaration;
they prove retention of supported content, not fidelity to the reference application's pagination
of the unsupported feature. This is recovery policy, not feature completion.
